function.text: SRP72 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP72. Annotated molecular activities include 7S RNA binding and TPR domain binding. It participates in SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, signal sequence recognition.
